clue.text: Notice the old man in study being po-faced

indicators.note: one thing sitting in another means the first pair of pieces goes inside the room named after it

parts.note: a den is a study or private room
an ad is a notice, a short advertisement
pa is an informal word for father

explanation.surface: Someone reading a notice their father has pinned up in the study keeps a straight, disapproving face.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Notice' looks like a verb, but it is a noun here, a short advertisement; 'in study' puts the first two pieces inside the room.
explanation.definitionFit: Both describe an expressionless, humourless face showing no emotion at all.

clue.text: Husband finally and woman said to be shattered

indicators.note: finally points to the closing letter of the word it follows

parts.note: the final letter of husband
a woman's name, a common crossword stand-in
to have stated something is to have said it

explanation.surface: A husband and his wife, it is reported, ended up utterly broken.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Said' here is not a sound-alike signal but a straight synonym, STATED; 'and' just joins the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Devastated and shattered are synonyms for being emotionally destroyed or overwhelmed by distress.

clue.text: Change last word of prayer, improved ultimately

parts.note: amen is said at the close of a prayer

indicators.note: ultimately means at the very end, so only the closing letter of the preceding word is used

parts.note: final letter of improved

explanation.surface: Someone revises how a prayer ends so the closing word is better.
explanation.definitionFit: To amend a text is to change or correct it, a straightforward verb synonym.

clue.text: Agent suffering setback? Then hard to keep going

indicators.note: a setback sends something backwards, so the word for agent is read from its end

parts.note: a rep is a sales agent or representative
severe conditions are hard ones

explanation.surface: A salesman has suffered a reverse and finds it hard to carry on.
explanation.definitionFit: To persevere is to continue steadily despite difficulty, which is what keeping going means.

clue.text: Troubled horse starts to get every disorder

parts.note: a nag is an old or poor horse

indicators.note: the starts of the following words means taking only their opening letters

parts.note: opening letters of get, every and disorder

explanation.surface: An ailing horse begins to pick up every disease going.
explanation.definitionFit: Nagged is used of a worry or pain that persistently troubled or bothered someone.

clue.text: Servant quiet, taking time

parts.note: p for piano, the musical direction to play quietly
an age is a long period of time

explanation.surface: A silent servant takes his time over his duties.
explanation.definitionFit: A page is a boy attendant or young servant, historically in a noble household.

clue.text: Vessel taking tons beyond Italian river

parts.note: the Po is the longest river in Italy
T is the abbreviation for tons; 'beyond' places it after the river

explanation.surface: A cargo ship carries tons of goods further than an Italian river.
explanation.definitionFit: A pot is a container, a vessel in the sense of something that holds liquid or food.

clue.text: Choc mixed with gin in dish

indicators.note: mixed means stirred together, so the letters lose their order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: An odd dessert combining chocolate and gin.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a boozy pudding, but the result is savoury Italian food.
explanation.definitionFit: Gnocchi are small Italian dumplings, a dish usually made from potato or semolina.

clue.text: Jockey very nasty, putting learner off

indicators.note: putting something off removes it, here the letter that stands for a learner driver

parts.note: vile means very nasty
L for learner, as on L-plates

explanation.surface: A horribly unpleasant rider unsettles a novice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Jockey' looks like the rider, but it is the verb, as in to jockey for position.
explanation.definitionFit: To jockey for position is to compete with others, so jockey as a verb is a synonym of vie.

clue.text: Broadcast got on air for church ceremony

indicators.note: broadcast means scattered widely, so the letters are strewn into a new order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A religious service was transmitted on radio.
explanation.definitionFit: Rogation is a Christian observance of solemn prayer and processions, traditionally before Ascension Day.

clue.text: Soldiers coming in chatted about their special unit?

indicators.note: about suggests moving around, so the letters of the verb are rearranged
coming in means entering, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: letters of chatted rearranged
soldiers are men in crosswords, as in officers and men

explanation.surface: Troops arriving gossiped about the elite squad they belong to.
explanation.definitionFit: A detachment is a group of troops sent away from the main force for a specific task.

clue.text: Plant, first thing for summer border

indicators.note: the first thing of a word is its opening letter

parts.note: opening letter of summer
an edge is a border

explanation.surface: A gardener's top choice of plant for a summer flower border.
explanation.definitionFit: Sedge is a grass-like plant that grows in wet ground, so the answer is a specific example.

clue.text: A repeated cheer, awkward problem for listener

indicators.note: awkward suggests something clumsy and out of shape, so the letters are reorganised

parts.note: the letter A given twice
taken as written

explanation.surface: A cheer chanted over and over becomes a nuisance for anyone hearing it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A repeated' means the article A twice, not a repeated cheer; both join the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: Earache is a pain in the ear, a problem that afflicts the organ we hear with.

clue.text: Cool drink perhaps about to be given to new student?

parts.note: re means about, concerning
a fresher is a first-year university student in Britain

explanation.surface: Is a cold drink going to be handed to a first-year undergraduate?
explanation.definitionFit: A refresher is something that revives you, and a cool drink is an example, hence the 'perhaps'.

clue.text: Journalist going to a club cooled off

parts.note: taken as written
a bat is a club used to strike a ball
ED is short for editor, the stock crossword journalist

explanation.surface: A reporter heading to a nightclub had calmed down.
explanation.walkthrough: The journalist comes first in the clue but last in the answer, since he is 'going to' the other pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that has abated has lessened in intensity, so it has cooled off or died down.

clue.text: Current measures? See a PM struggling to accommodate Right

indicators.note: something struggling is in disarray, so these letters are jumbled
to accommodate is to hold within, so one letter sits inside the rest

parts.note: letters of see, a and PM rearranged
R is the abbreviation for right

explanation.surface: Reports on present-day policies show a prime minister battling to placate the political right.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Current' pretends to mean present-day; it is electric current.
explanation.definitionFit: Amperes are the units by which electric current is measured, so they are measures of current.

clue.text: A father, one getting about a continent

parts.note: taken as written
Fr is the abbreviation for Father, the priest's title
I is the Roman numeral one
ca is short for circa, meaning about

explanation.surface: A priest and another person travelling around a continent.
explanation.definitionFit: Africa is one of the world's seven continents, the second largest by area.

clue.text: Begging when meeting monarch

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I arrived'
a king is a monarch

explanation.surface: Someone pleads on being introduced to the sovereign.
explanation.definitionFit: Asking and begging both mean requesting something, begging being an urgent or humble form.

clue.text: A fast train, say

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a rapid train making few stops
second meaning: to put a thought into words

explanation.walkthrough: 'Say' looks like 'for example', but it is a verb in its own right.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a noun for a rapid train and a verb meaning to convey a feeling in words.

clue.text: Planet in fear, threatened

indicators.note: in tells us the letters lie inside the following words, spanning the gap

parts.note: found across the end of one word and start of the next

explanation.surface: A world living in fear, under threat.
explanation.definitionFit: Earth is the third planet from the sun, the one we live on.

clue.text: Scout in play area by church

parts.note: the rec is a recreation ground, a public playing field in Britain
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A Boy Scout in a playground next to a church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Scout' looks like a noun for a Boy Scout but is the verb, to scout out.
explanation.definitionFit: A recce, short for reconnaissance, is a scouting mission; to recce is to scout an area.

clue.text: Mistake involving some lamb, maybe being salty

indicators.note: involving means wrapping in, so one piece is held inside the other

parts.note: bish is British slang for a blunder
a rack of lamb is a cut of ribs; 'maybe' flags it as one example

explanation.surface: A cook errs with a lamb dish by oversalting it.
explanation.definitionFit: Brackish water is slightly salty, like the mix of river and sea water in an estuary.

clue.text: Start to chew huge lettuce

indicators.note: the start of a word is its opening letter

parts.note: opening letter of chew
OS for outsize, the clothing label for very large

explanation.surface: Begin munching an enormous salad leaf.
explanation.definitionFit: Cos is a variety of lettuce with long crisp leaves, known as romaine in America.

clue.text: Rebel, the fellow confronted by Conservative

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for Conservative
he is the pronoun for a fellow

explanation.surface: An insurgent man faces a Tory opponent.
explanation.walkthrough: Being confronted by means the Conservative stands in front of the fellow.
explanation.definitionFit: Che Guevara was the Argentine-born Marxist revolutionary, the archetypal rebel.

clue.text: Flower in Oxford for goddess

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a flower is something that flows, a river, and this is the Thames's name in Oxford
second meaning: the Egyptian mother goddess

explanation.surface: A bloom grown in Oxford is chosen to honour a goddess.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flower' wants to be a bloom; read it as flow-er, a thing that flows, which is a river.
explanation.definitionFit: The Thames is called the Isis as it passes through Oxford, and Isis was a major Egyptian deity.

clue.text: Fellow covering limb in item of clothing

indicators.note: covering means going around the outside, so one piece wraps another

parts.note: a gent is a gentleman, a fellow
an arm is a limb

explanation.surface: A man wraps his arm in a piece of clothing.
explanation.definitionFit: A garment is any single article of clothing, such as a coat or shirt.
